title: What Did I Do This Month?
description: I wanted to generalize the github heat map to other areas of life. WDIDTM allows me to see at a glance how often I'm showing up for the things that matter. It's the perfect way for me to measure my longterm consistency towards my goals.

title: Caribbean Scholar
description: Online school intended for students taking the Caribbean Secondary Education Certificate (CSEC) exams. Built blog and marketing pages using gatsby with Wordpress backend. Used thinkific as Learning Management System.

title: Joey Games
description: Simple web application allowing users to play a simple memory game. Building using Next.js, Nest.js and Socket.io.
